topic: Brook's Yomi Yomi soul power beats borrowed soul power, which may be why he is the Straw Hat who can counter Imu in Elbaph
title: Brook Might Be The Straw Hat Who Counters Imu
description: Brook already walked back out of the land of the dead, and his soul has beaten borrowed soul power before. Here's my read on why that matters against Imu in Elbaph. Who counters Imu: Brook or Luffy?
comment: Who is Imu's real counter: Brook's soul or Zoro's blade? Pick one.

lines.text: Brook might be the one Straw Hat Imu can't touch.

shot.search: Brook Yomi Yomi no Mi soul
shot.fallback: skeleton musician with afro, glowing soul

lines.text: Here's my read, and it starts with his fruit.
Brook already died once, and his soul walked back out of the land of the dead.

shot.fallback: green soul flame floating over a skeleton

lines.text: In chapter 848, his soul overpowers the Homies, because they're built from borrowed scraps of other people's souls.
But chapter 853 shows the limit: Homies carrying Big Mom's own soul, he can't beat.

shot.fallback: giant pirate queen with living clouds

lines.text: So the rule is simple. Brook beats soul power that's borrowed, not soul power that's owned.

shot.search: Brook soul energy chill of the underworld

lines.text: Now look at Elbaph, where Imu possesses Gunko and turns the giants with Domi Reversi.
The best counter-argument: if Imu truly owns those souls, Brook loses, just like against Big Mom.
Maybe. But Gaban just fell into the Underworld, and Brook is the only person who has come back from it.

shot.fallback: skeleton musician at a dark gate

lines.text: So someone has to walk Gaban back, and I think that someone is Brook.
That's why Brook might be the one Straw Hat Imu can't touch.
